newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fire halts output at Brazil pulp firm Jari.
newsitem.headline: Fire halts output at Brazil pulp firm Jari.

text.p: A weekend fire has halted output at major Brazilian pulp maker Jari Celulose S.A. and production is unlikely to resume for at least four to six months, the company said.

In a statement sent to the local stock exchanges, preliminary findings showed the fire at its power generating plant in Monte Dourado in the northern state of Para damaged mainly cables and control panels.
It said output would be halted for four to six months "given that there is no other source of energy in the company or in the region."
The firm also said the company has fire insurance.
Private InvestNews agency said the fire is causing a 4.0 million reais daily loss to the company.
Trading in Jari stock had been suspended early this morning and resumed at 1200 local/1500 GMT on Sao Paulo bolsa.
